Fetal pancreas — QC cutoff review

Thresholds

Counts & genes
3.0
One-sided MAD on log1p, as in is_mad_outlier(). Flags cells below median − n·MAD only; high counts are a doublet question, not this step's.
% MT
5.0
median + n·MAD, clamped to [floor, cap]. Upper bound only.
% ribo
Off by default — high ribosomal content is often real biology in progenitors.
Reference
Olaniru 2023: >500 UMI, >250 genes, <25% MT.
